channel.title: Wire — Engineering
channel.description: Engineering from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Today's PHP security release, and how we're strengthening security
item.description: Describing the story behind how critical security vulnerabilities were found and fixed. (2 sources: hackernews, rprogramming)

item.title: The bridge to agent-scale Git infrastructure
item.description: We moved a copy of 99.99999% of GitHub's repositories to Azure. Here's how per-reference quorums will bring over the rest, and how object storage lets reads scale independently. (2 sources: githubblog, lobsters)

item.title: Presentation: Actors for Agents: Patterns for Production AI
item.description: Manju Rajashekhar explains how the actor model solves the complex runtime challenges of production AI agents. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Introducing full transaction detection for Cloudflare WAF
item.description: Cloudflare's web application firewall can now correlate an HTTP request with its response. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: Cloudflare deploys protections against php2shell vulnerability
item.description: Cloudflare has deployed default web application firewall (WAF) protections for newly disclosed PHP vulnerabilities before public disclosure. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: How Commerce.com and Cloudflare are getting storefronts ready for AI agents
item.description: Almost 100,000 Commerce.com domains now give AI agents real shopping tools through WebMCP on Cloudflare. Here's how we turned it on across every store at once, while keeping each merchant in control. (1 source: cloudflare)
